g.text: PVC DILUTE-PHASE CONVEYING VER 1 · OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
PVC RESIN DILUTE-PHASE PNEUMATIC CONVEYING · DAY SILO TO STORAGE SILOS
PVC d50 120 um, rho_p 1400, bulk 490 kg/m3
18 t/h, v / v_salt 1.20 at start of DN200
1. Rev 0 issued for teaching. Flags are the simulator model at design (noise off).
2. Flows in kg/h; temperatures in °C; pressures in bar absolute.
3. Conveying line 98 m: 33 m DN150 (0.16 m), step, 65 m DN200 (0.21 m); 6 bends, 3 diverters.
4. Streams 4, 12, 14 and 16 are zero at design (blow-off; silo B standby). Vent air 13 = conveying air, 3429 kg/h.
